from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    c=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    fill=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    wallrows=[i for i in range(H) if all(v!=fill for v in g[i])]
    wallcols=[j for j in range(W) if all(g[i][j]!=fill for i in range(H))]
    # bands between consecutive wall lines
    rb=[]
    for a,b in zip(wallrows,wallrows[1:]):
        if b>a+1: rb.append((a,b))
    cb=[]
    for a,b in zip(wallcols,wallcols[1:]):
        if b>a+1: cb.append((a,b))
    specials=set(c)-{fill}-{c.most_common(2)[1][0]} if len(c)>2 else set()
    # wall color = second most common? safer: colors appearing in wall rows/cols majority
    wallcol_cnt=Counter(v for i in wallrows for v in g[i])
    wall=wallcol_cnt.most_common(1)[0][0] if wallrows else None
    specials=set(c)-{fill,wall}
    m=[]
    for (r1,r2) in rb:
        row=[]
        for (c1,c2) in cb:
            corners={g[r1][c1],g[r1][c2],g[r2][c1],g[r2][c2]}
            if len(corners)==1 and corners<=specials:
                row.append(corners.pop())
            else:
                row.append(fill)
        m.append(row)
    # crop to bounding box of non-fill
    ps=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(m) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v!=fill]
    if not ps: return [[fill]]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in ps); r1=max(p[0] for p in ps)
    c0=min(p[1] for p in ps); c1=max(p[1] for p in ps)
    return [r[c0:c1+1] for r in m[r0:r1+1]]
